generation.explanation: In vertex form y = a(x − h)² + k, the vertex sits at (h, k): h slides the parabola left/right (note the sign — x − h moves it right when h is positive), and k slides it up/down. The coefficient a controls the width — |a| > 1 narrows it, |a| < 1 widens it — and a negative a flips it upside down. Use the sliders to change each value, or drag the red vertex directly and watch h and k update, with the gray parent parabola y = x² shown for comparison.
